duration.text: The Applied Chemistry at East China University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4333 USD/per year ￥ 31200 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Recommendation letter from employer 8. Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English.

requirements.text: 1. aged 18 or above and be in good health 2. Bachelor's degree diploma (English version) issued by accredited educational institution. 3. ELTS 6.5 or TOFEL 80 (Internet-based) or GMAT will be preferred;
